mapper.sql: FROM trade_order_publication_issue pi INNER JOIN trade_order o ON o.id = pi.order_id AND o.deleted = FALSE
mapper.select:
SELECT pi.delivery_type AS deliveryType, pi.school_id AS schoolId, MAX(pi.school_name_snapshot) AS schoolNameSnapshot, pi.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, MAX(pi.warehouse_name_snapshot) AS warehouseNameSnapshot, pi.window_id AS windowId, MAX(pi.window_name_snapshot) AS windowNameSnapshot, pi.offer_id AS offerId, pi.offer_sku_id AS offerSkuId, pi.sku_id AS skuId, MAX(pi.product_name_snapshot) AS productNameSnapshot, MAX(sku.name) AS productSkuName, MAX(sku_ext.isbn) AS isbn, pi.issue_id AS issueId, pi.issue_no AS issueNo, MAX(pi.issue_name) AS issueName, MIN(pi.planned_delivery_date) AS plannedDeliveryDate, COALESCE(SUM(pi.count), 0) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.order_id) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.student_id) AS studentCount
LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = pi.sku_id AND sku.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_publication_sku_ext sku_ext ON sku_ext.sku_id = pi.sku_id AND sku_ext.deleted = FALSE
GROUP BY pi.delivery_type, pi.school_id, pi.warehouse_id, pi.window_id, pi.offer_id, pi.offer_sku_id, pi.sku_id, pi.issue_id, pi.issue_no ORDER BY pi.delivery_type ASC, pi.issue_no ASC, pi.warehouse_id ASC, pi.offer_sku_id ASC, pi.sku_id ASC

SELECT pi.delivery_type AS deliveryType, pi.school_id AS schoolId, MAX(pi.school_name_snapshot) AS schoolNameSnapshot, pi.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, MAX(pi.warehouse_name_snapshot) AS warehouseNameSnapshot, pi.window_id AS windowId, MAX(pi.window_name_snapshot) AS windowNameSnapshot, COALESCE(SUM(pi.count), 0) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.order_id) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.student_id) AS studentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(COALESCE(pi.offer_id, 0), '#', COALESCE(pi.offer_sku_id, 0), '#', COALESCE(pi.sku_id, 0))) AS publicationGroupCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(COALESCE(pi.offer_id, 0), '#', COALESCE(pi.offer_sku_id, 0), '#', COALESCE(pi.sku_id, 0), '#', COALESCE(pi.issue_id, 0), '#', COALESCE(pi.issue_no, 0))) AS issueGroupCount
GROUP BY pi.delivery_type, pi.school_id, pi.warehouse_id, pi.window_id ORDER BY pi.delivery_type ASC, pi.warehouse_id ASC, pi.school_id ASC, pi.window_id ASC
